scripts.api:dev: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn autoresearch_api.main:app --app-dir apps/api/src --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.api:check: uv run --project apps/api python -m compileall apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.api:test:live: uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests/test_live_repositories.py apps/api/tests/test_live_programs_api.py
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres neo4j redis minio minio-init
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d neo4j redis minio minio-init
